evidence: Applied workbook row 36 (Quality Checks + Internal Quality Checks annotation) and quality-checks.md s.36 / deterministic-checks.md check-probe-not-in-seed.py procedure by hand: enumerated every distinctive value the judge is told to create across tests/gates/{render,constraints}/judge.toml, tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}/judge.toml and prompt.md, and searched the seed and reference initial state. Probes enumerated: J1/J2(/J3) job titles and A-F, V-Z candidate names, both explicitly suffixed/unique ('suffix every title and name for this review', tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:15; 'unique title'/'unique name, a unique email address', tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared; role replays require 'a new unique name and email ... new unique title ... new text', prompt.md:17); message 'plain' (prompt.md:39, hro_msg_compose); polish note draft 'Call back on Fri' (polish/judge.toml hro_pol_live_board); judge-chosen 'distinctive' replies (hro_pol_failed_send, hro_pol_session_resume); new note texts, rejection reasons, Mei Lin's newly added J1 card (V), Noor's/Tomas's new messages. Seed check: environment/assets/seed_data.json and solution/app/src/seed_data.json are byte-identical (sha256 a1c65c80...7f83740). Seed holds only 3 jobs (Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer), 16 applications, 127 messages (APP-101:120, APP-201:3, APP-301:3, APP-302:1), 3 notes, 6 read markers and NO activity rows. grep for '', 'Call back', 'Fri', 'J1', 'J2', 'J3', 'draft', 'seen' in the seed: 0 hits ('plain' only matches 'explained' in generated_note). Reference initial state: solution/app/src/db.js seedIfEmpty (lines 57-84) inserts only users/jobs/applications/messages/reads/notes; the activity table (db.js:49) starts empty; solution/app/public/index.html (35 lines) contains only the sign-in form, no prefilled values; public JS only has placeholder 'Reason for rejecting' (board.js:21,216), a placeholder not a value, and the blank-reason check needs an empty value. Collision-prone probe handled: tomas.varga@candidates.example already has seeded APP-201 (Data Analyst, SCREEN) with a 3-message conversation, but hro_candidate_linked requires the card added on the review-created, suffixed J2 to become Tomas's application; protocol T says 'if that address is already on J2, open a new job J3', and the seeded-conversation fallback is explicitly not credited to the link ('This row alone owns that link'). So an app that never links new cards cannot pass via the seeded Data Analyst application. Similarly Ingrid/Bill seeded manager assignments (Platform Engineer/Data Analyst) do not satisfy J1/J2 manager rows, which use the judge-assigned J1/J2 managers. Unread/seen rows are state-relative ('rises by exactly two', 'counts read relative to their values before you act'). Seeded reads used (Lena 1 unread: 3 messages vs read_count 2; Platform Engineer order Greta/Ade/Marco + Priya/Samuel; Noor note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.') are deliberate durability/seed-fidelity reads, not mutation probes; the seed values match the prompt. hro_restart's mutation proof comes from review-created jobs, cards, notes, messages, unread counts and activity lines, which are absent from the seed. Weak-app attempt: an app that ignores writes but displays seeded data cannot show any suffixed J1/J2 record, 'plain', a new note or a new activity line, because none pre-exists; a conforming app is not penalised by any probe colliding with seed. No defect found. This is a static source property; no runtime run is needed for this row, and none was claimed.
